newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates to launch sea route to Iraq in a few days.
- Saudi Arabia urges foreigners to invest in share funds.
- Jordanian Housing Bank agrees to raise its capital to $50 million dinars.
- King Fahd says Israel's insistence to build more settlements in Arab East Jerusalem would affect peace process.
- Palestinian trade team in Cairo for talks on boosting bilateral ties.
- Jordan and India to open joint chemical plant.
